name: Dolly In
description: A camera move you drop onto a still: the camera glides forward on a track, focus held, background compressing. Bring your own subject line.
prompt: Slow smooth dolly in toward {{subject}}, camera glides forward on a track, focus held on the subject, background compresses, no zoom, {{extra}}
negative_prompt: zoom lens breathing, shake, cuts, morphing, text

slots.name: subject
slots.label: Subject
slots.help: What the camera moves toward, e.g. 'the chai glass on the counter'.

slots.name: extra
slots.label: Anything else
slots.default: keep the light of the still

author: kilnry
